title: OptimDase: An Algorithm for Predicting DNA Binding Sites with Combined Feature Encoding.
authors: Liu, Zhendong; Liu, Jun S; Wei, Dongqing; Man, Rongjun; Jiang, Jiamin; Zhang, Bofeng; Li, Liping; Zhao, Zhiyong
one_liner_zh: 提出结合特征编码与最优决策框架的OptimDase算法用于DNA结合位点预测，虽属蛋白-DNA互作范畴但未聚焦TF-DNA三维机制，方法为传统机器学习特征工程，对课题有参考价值。
abstract: Identifying DNA binding sites remains a critical task in bioinformatics, with applications ranging from gene regulation studies to drug design. Although progress has been made in computational techniques, we still face challenges such as data complexity and prediction accuracy. In this paper, we introduce OptimDase, a new algorithm. It integrates feature encoding with optimum decision-making frameworks to improve DNA binding site prediction. OptimDase integrates multi-scale scanning and feature selection strategies, making it highly effective for both classification and regression tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that OptimDase achieves superior performance with an accuracy of 0.8943 in classification tasks and an RMSE of 0.0054 in regression tasks, outperforming existing algorithms in key evaluation metrics. These results highlight OptimDase's portability and robustness, making it an effective solution for identifying DNA binding sites and advancing the applications of drug design.
abstract_zh: 识别DNA结合位点仍然是生物信息学中的一个关键任务，其应用范围从基因调控研究到药物设计。尽管计算技术已取得进展，我们仍面临数据复杂性和预测准确性等挑战。在本文中，我们介绍了一种新算法OptimDase。它整合了特征编码与最优决策框架，以改进DNA结合位点预测。OptimDase集成了多尺度扫描和特征选择策略，使其在分类和回归任务中均表现出高效性。我们的实验表明，OptimDase在分类任务中实现了0.8943的准确率，在回归任务中实现了0.0054的均方根误差（RMSE），在关键评估指标上优于现有算法。这些结果突显了OptimDase的可移植性和鲁棒性，使其成为识别DNA结合位点并推进药物设计应用的有效解决方案。
